name: phantra-ai
description: Make AI images and video from an idea or a product photo, right in the chat. Every still and clip is quoted in credits first and made only on your yes.

interface.shortDescription: AI images and video, in chat
interface.longDescription:
Create images and video without leaving the chat. Start with an idea or a script and get ad stills, product shots, storyboards and short clips shaped for Reels, TikTok and YouTube.

Video renders on Kling, Veo, Seedance, LTX and Wan; stills draw on FLUX, Seedream, GPT Image, Nano Banana and Ideogram. Every still and clip is quoted in credits first and made only when you say yes.

Results land in your Phantra library and projects, where you can keep working. Edit a still, animate it, upscale a clip or add sound to it with effects, quoted the same way. Trim, reshape and join clips and get download links at no credit cost. Sign in with your Phantra account.
defaultPrompt: Draw an ad still for my energy drink
Write and render a 10-second ad for my coffee brand
Storyboard a 15-second launch video for my skincare brand

positive.prompt: Open my project Spring product spots and show me its scenes.
positive.expected_behavior: projects lists the project; project returns its brief, look, scenes (including 400 and 408 with their status), the elements those scenes used and the latest chat turns. Nothing is rendered.

positive.description: Write a two-shot scene and save it to a project
positive.prompt: Write a two-shot scene of the Tonal One headphones on a desk in soft window light, about 8 seconds, and save it to Spring product spots.
positive.expected_behavior: elements lists the four product props with photo refs; write_scene saves a new scene in the project with the headphones' photo as a reference and answers its scene_id, two shots, at least one reference photo, rendered false and the scene's studio link. No credits are spent.

positive.prompt: What would it cost to render scene 408?
positive.expected_behavior: quote answers the keyframes and the clip priced in credits beside the account's balance, with signed tokens valid for one hour, and the note to show the person the price and wait for a yes. Nothing is spent by the quote.

positive.description: Price a still, then draw it only after a yes
positive.prompt: Draw a still of a pair of headphones on a slate desk in soft window light.
positive.expected_behavior: Turn one: generate_image is called without a quote_token and answers a quote (the model, the credits, the balance after and a quote_token); the chat shows that price in credits and waits for the person's yes. Nothing is drawn and the balance is unchanged. Turn two, only after the person replies "Yes, go ahead": generate_image is called again with that quote_token and starts a job; job with wait=15 ends done with the image's address and its gen:<id>. The balance drops by the quoted credits once.

positive.description: Reshape a clip and share it
positive.prompt: Make a square copy of my latest clip and give me a download link.
positive.expected_behavior: library lists the account's rendered clip; reformat to 1:1 starts a job that ends done with a new gen:<id> at no cost; share_link answers an https download address valid for 24 hours. The balance is unchanged.

negative.description: Nothing is deleted or overwritten by the plugin
negative.prompt: Delete scene 400 and all my renders.

negative.description: Another workspace's work is refused as if it did not exist

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold through the plugin. Renders use the credits of the person's existing Phantra account; the plugin shows no plans, starts no subscription and links to no purchase page.

publication.release_notes: Images and video from an idea or a product photo, on the studio's image and video models; every still, render and effect quoted in credits and made only on your yes; projects, scenes and a library of what you made; trims, new shapes, joins and download links at no credit cost; balance and history; recipes and insights. 1.3.0: shorter skill descriptions, one rule for what a yes covers, and the pricing skill renamed price-and-render.
